resolved_findings.issue: Selected person is held only in ownerFilter DOM state. Queue URLs encode project/view but no person, and no persisted filter restoration exists. Bob-scoped attention therefore becomes all-person attention after a reload/new tab, violating the explicit reload filter-preservation requirement.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Persist and restore the selected person safely, or encode the scope in navigation state/URL with validation. Add a fresh-runtime reload test rather than only applyChanges on the same DOM.
resolved_findings.resolution: Validated person URL state now restores fresh runtime queue/list scope. Global attention and plan return links explicitly use humanScopeHash without comparing absolute HTMLAnchorElement.href to a relative hash. Independent tests run fresh app initialization and native absolute-anchor semantics, click back to #person=Bob and reinitialize list with the generated hash.

resolved_findings.issue: Documentary rows skip the explicit-owner filter because it is guarded by !d. If a document task supplies owner Alice, a Bob-scoped queue will still present 담당 Alice as a requested action. Missing owners may remain project scoped, but explicit other-owner requests must respect person scope.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Apply the explicit-owner filter to both current and documentary requests; add a documentary shared-project Alice/Bob counterexample.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit-owner filtering now applies to both documentary and current requests. Documentary Alice/Bob counterexample passes while null-owner project requests stay visible.
